road-dempster-highway.summary: A expedition highway from Dawson City, Yukon to Tuktoyaktuk, Northwest Territories, via Eagle Plains. Key character: Arctic tundra; remote ranges; permafrost. Surface: gravel.
road-dempster-highway.source: built from the road itself, as recorded in the scenic atlas
road-dempster-highway.slogan: A 1687 km loop out of Dawson City
road-dempster-highway.story: A 1687 km round trip from Dawson City - roughly 28 h 07 in the saddle. The stops in between: Tombstone Territorial Park, Eagle Plains, Inuvik and Tuktoyaktuk. The highest point is about 1,600 m. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
